title: Statehood
description: California achieved statehood 1850 (31st). The road to statehood ran through territorial government, population thresholds, and a congressional enabling act — the standard American path. Gold Rush 1849; statehood 1850. Statehood Day is still celebrated, and the admission order gives California its number among the states.

title: Capital: Sacramento
